title: Can I introduce my boyfriend to my grandmother? Evaluating Large Language Models Capabilities on Iranian Social Norm Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance of LLMs on the Iranian Social Norms (ISN) dataset by comparing model predictions using default prompts versus culturally-specific prompts (explicitly asking for an Iranian perspective) in both English and Farsi.

Conducting an error analysis on model misclassifications to identify frequent failure patterns across intersecting demographic attributes (e.g., gender, religion, educational role), such as the model incorrectly predicting taboo behaviors for females, Muslims, and teachers.
Comparing the LLMs' social norm classification performance when the prompt's context (environment, demographic attributes, and norms) is presented in English versus Farsi (a low-resource language).
